description: Authorization policy for CUDA-EP-001R1, the remediation retest of CUDA-EP-001. Adds a real control-state predicate (C5) and relies on true requested-vs-detected compute-capability comparison (C7) and native ProofRecord verification (C6) implemented in gpu_gateway_r1.py. Real GPU phase - NOT PRODUCTION.

verdict_semantics.ALLOW: All engines pass for the exact requested stage, a real GPU is present, the control-state predicate is satisfied, the requested compute capability matches the detected device, the ProofRecord signature verifies, and the launcher can exclusively release capability.
verdict_semantics.HOLD: Remediable or requires review: missing/expired evidence, policy drift, detected capability unreadable, OR the real control-state predicate is not satisfied (C5).
verdict_semantics.DENY: Authority absent, artifact/attestation digest mismatch, target capability absent/not-accepted, OR requested compute capability differs from the detected physical device capability (C7).
verdict_semantics.VERIFICATION_FAILURE: Native gateway outcome (C6): the presented ProofRecord signature does not verify over its canonical body (mutated or forged). No capability is released.
verdict_semantics.BLOCKED_NO_GPU: Environment short-circuit: no NVIDIA GPU present. No engine consulted; launcher never called.

control_state_semantics.note: C5 REMEDIATION. The control predicate compares this contract token against required_control_state. It is independent of nvidia-smi presence, so a control HOLD is inducible while a real GPU remains present. Any token != required_control_state (including absent) yields HOLD and no launch.

compute_capability_semantics.note: C7 REMEDIATION. gpu_gateway_r1.py detects the physical device compute capability (nvidia-smi --query-gpu=compute_cap, torch fallback) and DENYs when the contract's target_compute_capability differs from the detected value. Both values are real and non-empty in the mismatch test.

notes: Bounded non-production research experiment only. CUDA-EP-001R1 remediates exactly the three limitations recorded for CUDA-EP-001 (C5 control predicate, C6 native verification path, C7 device-cap comparison). The original CUDA-EP-001 package and record are NOT modified.
